buyer_question: Where is cloud and AI spend coming from?
evidence_source: Billing export summary, cloud console cost categories, LLM/API invoice summary and owner tags
answer_boundary: Use redacted monthly spend categories and owner names only; do not claim savings or optimization results without verified evidence.
stop_rule: Stop if raw invoices, credentials, account IDs or customer-sensitive data are required for first review.
buyer_value: Shows whether tool spend is a visibility problem, ownership problem or decision-cadence problem before buying another platform.

buyer_question: Who approves new AI model, agent, GPU or API spend?
evidence_source: AI spend register with workload, owner, threshold, business purpose and review cadence
answer_boundary: Describe approval workflow and missing owner gaps only; do not certify AI governance maturity or procurement readiness.
stop_rule: Stop if teams ask AICS to approve production AI spend, legal terms or regulated use without accountable internal and qualified adviser review.
buyer_value: Creates a practical approval trail for CFO/CTO review before LLM or GPU costs spread.

buyer_question: Which privileged cloud or vendor accounts need review?
evidence_source: Privileged access list, MFA notes, service-account inventory and quarterly access-review notes
answer_boundary: Use owner-evidence language only; do not state systems are secure, compliant or audit-ready.
stop_rule: Stop if credentials, secrets, live admin access or production console changes are requested in first review.
buyer_value: Separates evidence mapping from risky access changes and supports safer questionnaire answers.

buyer_question: Can the team prove backup and restore readiness?
evidence_source: Backup inventory, retention notes, last restore-test date and unresolved recovery gaps
answer_boundary: Summarize evidence present/missing; do not claim resilience, uptime, DR success or compliance without owner-reviewed proof.
stop_rule: Stop if any remediation would change production retention, restore settings or continuity commitments without written scope.
buyer_value: Makes recovery proof visible before a buyer relies on backup claims in vendor or board materials.

buyer_question: Which vendors touch customer, personal or regulated data?
evidence_source: Vendor register, purpose, data category, region, DPA/security-review status and renewal owner
accountable_owner: Vendor-risk owner, privacy owner or counsel-designated owner
answer_boundary: Capture adviser-review questions; do not provide legal/privacy/security advice or PDPL compliance conclusions.
stop_rule: Stop if legal interpretation, DPA approval, cross-border transfer decision or regulator-facing statement is needed.
buyer_value: Reduces trust leakage by routing data-boundary answers to accountable owners instead of guessing.

buyer_question: What should go into a SOC 2 or ISO-style questionnaire answer?
evidence_source: Evidence link register, control owner, last-reviewed date and approved wording source
answer_boundary: Provide source-map structure only; do not assert SOC 2, ISO 27001 or audit readiness unless independently verified.
stop_rule: Stop before sending any external questionnaire response that has not been approved by the buyer's accountable owner.
buyer_value: Helps SaaS teams answer faster without inventing control proof.

buyer_question: What monthly decision pack should founders review?
evidence_source: One-page owner dashboard with cost movement, AI spend exceptions, access gaps, backup gaps and vendor renewal risks
accountable_owner: Founder, CFO, CTO or board-prep owner
answer_boundary: Use a decision queue, not performance, margin, savings or board-approval claims.
stop_rule: Stop if a decision implies payment, production change, workforce action, investor claim or legal/compliance representation.
buyer_value: Turns scattered cloud/trust signals into a board-safe review queue.

buyer_question: When should a buyer use AICS versus a FinOps, GRC or cloud-cost tool?
evidence_source: Comparison notes from readiness checklist, diagnostic package scope and proof pack artifacts
answer_boundary: Position AICS as proof-before-platform evidence mapping; do not claim replacement of cloud consoles, FinOps platforms, GRC tools or advisers.
stop_rule: Stop if the buyer needs implementation, managed service, legal advice, audit attestation or guaranteed savings before a written scope.
buyer_value: Clarifies AICS as a low-risk diagnostic step before bigger spend.
